entries.scope: This repository's management pages when the user requests the established PC and responsive review scope
entries.trigger: A broad page audit is requested without a narrower viewport instruction.
entries.required_action: Include the supported PC viewport and responsive layouts only. Do not add mobile-native or touch-device acceptance unless the user asks for it. Record actual CSS viewport and project-supported breakpoints in the trace.
entries.regression_check: The contract lists only the requested PC and responsive environments, and every in-scope page has evidence for each declared environment.

entries.source: User corrections on missed layout defects, 2026-09-29
entries.scope: All in-scope management pages, including nested routes, details, dialogs, drawers, and tabs
entries.trigger: A task requests validation of all pages or a deep page-layout review.
entries.required_action: Finish one page at a time from top to actual scroll end. Inventory and inspect each visible region and each relevant conditional surface before marking that page reviewed; then proceed to the next page.
entries.regression_check: Each page/environment pair has a complete region inventory, full-scroll evidence, checks for applicable conditional surfaces, and no unreviewed required region.

entries.scope: Acceptance tasks that include marked or annotated UI screenshots
entries.trigger: The user marks an area, draws an arrow, crosses out content, or describes a missed visual defect.
entries.required_action: Translate every distinct marked area or correction into a separate observable assertion. Verify it against the live page, identify the owning component, and retain evidence whether it passes or fails.
entries.regression_check: Every annotation maps to a numbered/identified acceptance assertion with a live-page result and evidence; none is treated as decorative context.
evidence_required: source/owner trace when a defect is found

entries.scope: Management list, dashboard, directory, configuration, and detail pages in this repository
entries.trigger: Reviewing a page with filters/search, list/table, actions, tabs, or pagination.
entries.required_action: Explicitly inspect alignment and wrapping of search/filter/action controls; refresh placement; operation-column width and alignment; pagination control, page-size selector, and total-count relationship; tab spacing; unexplained whitespace; redundant instructional copy; and overlap between helper text and table headers.
entries.regression_check: The region checklist has a concrete observation for every hotspot present on the page at each declared viewport; visible defects receive a finding and targeted retest.

entries.source: User request to avoid repeated verification, 2026-09-29
entries.scope: Repeated acceptance runs over this repository's pages and flows
entries.trigger: A route or assertion was verified in an earlier run.
entries.required_action: Check prior evidence and compare build/commit, route, role, data, state, browser, and viewport before reuse. Rerun only stale, failed, changed, or newly requested assertions; do not repeat a passing unchanged check without a reason.
entries.regression_check: The report links reused evidence and states why its baseline still matches; every changed or failed assertion has a new attempt.

entries.scope: Management page headers and breadcrumbs in this repository
entries.trigger: Reviewing or changing a page header that includes navigation context, a menu control, or page title.
entries.required_action: Keep the breadcrumb/navigation context as part of the page shell unless the current page requirement explicitly says otherwise. Improve alignment, spacing, hierarchy, and responsive behavior instead of removing the header region globally.
entries.regression_check: The page retains useful breadcrumb context and the menu/title/breadcrumb layout is aligned and usable at every declared viewport.
evidence_required: page header screenshot at each declared viewport
